title: tc-permission-request
description: An agent asks for one specific right: what will happen, for how long, Allow or Deny – then one line with a countdown.

action.description: What it wants to do, lower case after "wants to", e.g. "push to main"

target.description: Where, e.g. "acme/web" – shown with the tool's mark

risk.description: How much harm the action can do: safe shows no pill, risky a warning, destructive a danger pill and no "always"

reason.description: The agent's own words on why it needs this

preview.description: What will happen if you allow it – files, recipients, amounts

previewTitle.description: The heading over the preview list, e.g. "5 files will change"

scopes.description: The choices offered; "always" is never offered for destructive actions, "emergency" only when listed here

decision.description: The decision – null while it waits

now.description: The clock for the countdown, epoch ms – unset uses an internal clock

urgencies.description: Emergency access: the urgency windows to pick from, as data

emergencyNote.description: Emergency access: what it means, said above the justification

emergencyRemaining.description: Emergency access: the time left as the app reports it, e.g. "3 h 12 min" – shown in the banner, never computed here

emergencyEnded.description: Emergency access: the app says it has ended – the banner turns into the review-due note

reviewDue.description: Emergency access: when the review afterwards is due, as text, e.g. "by Fri 31 Oct"

meta.description: Right-aligned, e.g. "+12 −4" or "$240.00" – text, or an element (cloned)

window.description: The window, as text, e.g. "15 min"

PermissionUrgency.description: An urgency window for emergency access – how soon someone must look at it
